, (SELECT COALESCE(flt15_note, '') FROM flt15_tr_status WHERE flt15_company_id = emp01_company_id AND flt15_person_id = emp01_person_id AND flt15_date = (CASE WHEN flt02_check_cycle = '2' THEN f_get_last_day(CAST(#{stdDate} AS date)) ELSE f_get_last_day((f_get_quarter_date(CAST(#{stdDate} AS date),'1') + interval '3month')::date) END)) AS flt02_note

, CASE WHEN flt02_check_cycle = '2' THEN f_get_last_day(CAST(#{stdDate} AS date)) ELSE f_get_last_day((f_get_quarter_date(CAST(#{stdDate} AS date),'1') + interval '3month')::date) END AS flt02_note_date FROM emp LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT emp01_person_id as person_id , count(*) as violate_cnt FROM () ta GROUP BY emp01_person_id ) tb ON person_id = emp01_person_id LEFT OUTER JOIN flt15_tr_status ON ( flt15_company_id = emp01_company_id AND flt15_person_id = emp01_person_id AND flt15_date = (CASE WHEN flt02_check_cycle = '2' THEN f_get_last_day(CAST(#{stdDate} AS date)) ELSE f_get_last_day((f_get_quarter_date(CAST(#{stdDate} AS date),'1') + interval '3month')::date) END) ) WHERE UPPER(CONCAT(org02_kor_nm,emp01_kor_nm)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) ) e ORDER BY flt02_emp_id
